lemma helper_prime_gt_zero (p : ℕ) (_ : Nat.Prime p) : 0 < p := by exact?

-- Helper: All primes are at least 2

lemma helper_prime_ge_two (p : ℕ) (_ : Nat.Prime p) : 2 ≤ p := by exact?

-- Helper: Two primes are comparable

lemma helper_compare_primes (p q : ℕ) (_ : Nat.Prime p) (_ : Nat.Prime q) :
    p ≤ q ∨ q ≤ p := by omega

-- Helper: Square root bound

lemma helper_square_lower_bound (p q : ℕ) (_ : Nat.Prime p) (_ : Nat.Prime q) (m : ℕ) 
    (h_eq : p^2 + 7*p*q + q^2 = m^2) :
    m ≥ p + q := by nlinarith

-- Helper: Backward implication (sufficient conditions work)

lemma helper_implication_backward (p q : ℕ) (_ : Nat.Prime p) (_ : Nat.Prime q) 
    (h_disj : p = q ∨ (p = 3 ∧ q = 11) ∨ (p = 11 ∧ q = 3)) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, p^2 + 7*p*q + q^2 = m^2 := by cases h_disj with
    | inl h =>
        subst h
        use 3 * p
        ring
    | inr h_or =>
        cases h_or with
        | inl h_and =>
            rcases h_and with ⟨hp, hq⟩
            rw [hp, hq]
            use 19
            norm_num
        | inr h_and =>
            rcases h_and with ⟨hp, hq⟩
            rw [hp, hq]
            use 19
            norm_num

-- Helper: Special case p=3, q=11 works

lemma helper_case_p3_q11_square :
    ∃ m : ℕ, 3^2 + 7*3*11 + 11^2 = m^2 := by use 19; norm_num

-- Helper: Special case p=11, q=3 works

lemma helper_case_p11_q3_square :
    ∃ m : ℕ, 11^2 + 7*11*3 + 3^2 = m^2 := by use 19; norm_num

-- Helper: If p=q, the expression is a perfect square

lemma helper_equal_primes_work (p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, p^2 + 7*p*p + p^2 = m^2 := by use 3*p; ring

-- Helper: Expression equals (p+q)^2 + 5pq

lemma helper_expand_expression (p q : ℕ) :
    p^2 + 7*p*q + q^2 = (p + q)^2 + 5*p*q := by ring

-- Helper: If p≠q and p² + 7pq + q² = m², then m > p + q

lemma helper_strict_lower_bound (p q : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hq : Nat.Prime q)
    (h_neq : p ≠ q) (h_eq : ∃ m, p^2 + 7*p*q + q^2 = m^2) :
    ∃ m, m > p + q := by exact?
